title: LegendBoard - Web Game
author: Legendboard1
selftext:
Hey! I've been working on a browser game and would love some feedback.

[https://legendboard.online/](https://legendboard.online/)  
  
It's still very much a work in progress, but you can already explore the game world and play two minigames connected to it. The highest scores from the minigames are displayed on the in-game "LegendBoard" where players compete for the top spot.

Any feedback, suggestions, or ideas are greatly appreciated. Thanks for checking it out!

AI tools used:  
Chat - Image, Meshy - 3D animations, Suno - music, Claude - coding.

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Nice start! First suggestion, the home page needs to show the game, its asking me to sign up butI'm not sold on the experience yet.

replies.author: Highwalker321
replies.body: Yea totally agree I need more screenshots and gameplay video to look at before I'm signing up.

replies.author: Legendboard1
replies.body: Fixed! : ) No registration is required to try the game anymore.

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body:
I would label your game as a pre-alpha right now. Some areas of improvemnt:

1. Avatars need a resting mode for when they are not walking in run  
2. Put all text into an i18n system so you can easily translate into different launches later  
3. You need to develop your core loop

replies.author: Legendboard1
replies.body:
Thanks, really good feedback! I will keep it in mind as I continue developing the game. 

I have actually started working on the third minigame (for the Sci-Fi Village) but I think I will slow down a bit and make sure I get the core foundation right.

replies.author: Legendboard1
replies.body:
Thanks, Great point!

I've updated it so you no longer need to create an account to play (the reason registration was originally required was so the in-game leaderboard could accurately display the players with the highest scores). I've now changed it so that only players who want to compete on the leaderboard need to create an account.

comments.author: bingewavecinema
comments.body: Also, submit your game here for more exposure, we're having a festival for Ai games: [https://www.glitch.fun/gameshows/9eadde86-a1b2-4882-86e4-a3e9e2e08814/view/standalone](https://www.glitch.fun/gameshows/9eadde86-a1b2-4882-86e4-a3e9e2e08814/view/standalone)
